svg.title: Figure 3-1. Recovered hardware block diagram of the comma device, panda safety MCU and harness (WP-H-02 §3.1)
svg.desc: The vehicle (E210 Corolla TSS2) provides 12 V and ground, the forward camera on the camera-side CAN and the vehicle CAN on the car side. The E-05 harness contains the intercept relay HE-08 (de-energised: camera connected to car, the stock path, AOU-13; energised: camera to panda bus 2 and panda bus 0 to car, coil supply unknown, no readback), the ignition line HE-10 and the USB-C-type harness connector HE-09 carrying SBU1/SBU2, CAN and power. In the E-04 comma device, the power input (DC/DC and PMIC, unknown) feeds the SoC rail and the MCU rail. The application SoC (Snapdragon 845, AGNOS Linux, openpilot, QM, E-01) connects to road cameras, the IR driver camera, display and touch, speaker and amplifier, modem, Wi-Fi, GNSS and IMU, and to the panda safety MCU STM32H725 by SPI4 with DMA2 (IF-04, HE-11), the reset and boot-mode lines STM_RST_N and STM_BOOT0 (HE-12), a SOM GPIO to PC2, and the bootkick and SOM reset from the MCU (HE-13). The MCU contains FDCAN3 with XCVR3 on bus 2 (camera), FDCAN2 with XCVR2 or XCVR4 on bus 1 (multiplexed by orientation), FDCAN1 with XCVR1 on bus 0 (car) (HE-07), two relay drive lines (HE-08), the ADC for SBU1/SBU2 sense, ignition and Vin (HE-09, HE-10, HE-14), flash HE-02, SRAM HE-03, clock HE-04, IWDG1 HE-06, the core HE-01, the die temperature sensor HE-15, MCU supply HE-05 and USB OTG HS, and drives the fan HE-16 (TIM3 PWM, tach on EXTI2), the siren HE-17 (I2C5 on tres, TIM7 and SAI4 on cuatro) and the IR LEDs (PWM on tres).
svg.text: Figure 3-1 · Hardware block diagram (recovered from code)
comma 3X (tres) / comma four (cuatro) with panda safety MCU STM32H725, E-05 harness and intercept relay · bus numbers of the Toyota safety mode
USB-C-type harness connector · SBU1/SBU2 + CAN + power
Cortex-M7, 240 MHz · runs the E-03 firmware
SoC rail (QM) and MCU rail both come from the device input. The MCU keeps
running with the SoC off and can switch SoC power (bootkick, HE-13).
Unknown: shared regulator (UK-05), supply supervisor, relay coil supply
